combinations.readout: mechanical allodynia (paw withdrawal threshold, operated paw)
combinations.magnitude: PWT 32.53 ± 3.71 vs 15.46 ± 2.27 (vehicles, p = 0.028) and vs 11.35 ± 2.63 (HEC plus morphine, p = 0.008)
combinations.model: partial sciatic nerve ligation neuropathic pain
combinations.evidence_quote: Namely, at the peak-effect of the compounds, a significantly higher PWT of the operated paws was observed in the combination group when compared with the group treated with their vehicles (PWT: 32.53 ± 3.71, n = 6 vs. 15.46 ± 2.27, n = 4; p = 0.028) or 1% HEC plus morphine (PWT: 32.53 ± 3.71, n = 6 vs. 11.35 ± 2.63, n = 5; p = 0.008) (Figure 2d,e).

combinations.magnitude: failed to alleviate NP acutely or after 10 days
combinations.model: partial sciatic nerve ligation neuropathic pain
combinations.evidence_quote: On the other hand, the combination of subanalgesic doses of losartan and morphine failed to alleviate NP either on the 1st day of treatment (acute effect) or after 10 days of chronic administration (Figure 2b,c).

combinations.magnitude: significant antinociception maintained on days 4 and 10, peaking at 30 min and lasting up to 3 h, whereas morphine alone lost effect by day 10
combinations.evidence_quote: However, when morphine was combined with oral telmisartan, a significant antinociception was maintained on the 4th and 10th day as well, peaking at 30 min and lasting up to 3 h (Figure 4a,b).

combinations.magnitude: significant increase only with the combination
combinations.model: pSNL neuropathic pain and morphine-tolerant rats
combinations.evidence_quote: Based on samples from both mononeuropathic and morphine-tolerant animals, only the combination of telmisartan and morphine significantly increased CSF L-glutamate content.
